QuestInfo.name: Robeira's introduction letter
QuestInfo.0: I've reached a limit to my training as a magician Is there a level beyond this? I should ask #b#p2020009##k who helped me with the third job advancement.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p2020009##k told me to see the bishop #b#p2081200##k in Minar Forest if I want to find the path of becoming a wiser magician.
QuestInfo.2: #b#p2081200##k said he will guide me to the path that will lead me to the magician's extreme power.

0.0: Long time no see. I'm happy to see you improved. Did you find the truth in your mind? Then you must have some reason to be here. What can I do for you?\r\n#b#L0# I want the 4th job advancement.#l#k
0.1: Yes. I was expecting you. But I don't have enough power to help you. Go to #bMinar Forest#k. #b#p2081200##k will help make your dream come true. Do you want to see him?

yes.0: Then I'll recommend you to him. Don't be rude to him. May you find the power you seek!

no.0: Aren't you here for the 4th job advancement? If you don't want it, that's fine.

1.0: What are you doing here young magician?\r\n#b#L0# I want 4th job advancement. I have a recommendation letter from #p2020009#.#l
1.1: #b#p2020009##k?... That's the one who lives in El Nath. If she recommended you, I can trust you.

yes.0: A young magician dreaming of being an Arch Mage. I have to tell you a few stories. Talk to me when you're ready.

npc.0: Remember. The bishop of Minar Forest, #b#p2081200##k. Please see him.

lost.0: You lost #b#t4031342##k? I will write again but be careful.
